notes.title: Euryale's Gambit Sequel Coming Soon
notes.content:
It's been a little over a year since the 1.0 version of Euryale's Gambit was released.  The wait for the sequel is almost over.  Starting in October, Athena's Revenge will enter Early Access.

Wishlist Athena's Revenge https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414260/Athenas_Revenge/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40858079/0670f1a038260cba4e0bb23d4f2f887154e3528f.png[/img]

The main focal point in Athena's Revenge is the redemption of Stheno.  She is known for her cold heart and serious demeanor.  She has incredible innate strength and the ability to use chaos energy makes her an incredibly dangerous Gorgon.  Will her strength be enough to slay three demon lords and rescue Medusa from Athena?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40858079/2a26e91c297a570c0086ae675d7c53dd90a12f64.png[/img]

Luckily for Stheno, Euryale (the younger) is accompanying her on her mission.  Euryale has no memory of Medusa and has just had a curse of apathy lifted from her.  She finds herself trying to save Medusa with her sister Stheno while also navigating emotions she can't remember ever feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40858079/a893d2b0146ef122f74b752917cd9704efc6cc68.png[/img]

Finally, Ashmedai, the half-demon, half-succubus joins the fight as she will try to save her aunts, the succubus queens, from the demon lords who are blackmailing her mother, Queen Igret.  Ashmedai also plans on finally confronting her father, the demon lord Abaddon.  She really hates him!

Features:
[list]
[*] The continuation of Euryale and Stheno's journey
[*] High quality graphics and animations
[*] Music and sound effects
[*] Optional pure-lesbian and futanari routes
[/list]

Don't forget to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414260/Athenas_Revenge/]Athena's Revenge[/url] so that you'll be notified when it's released.

Special thanks to all of you who have supported the development of Euryale's Gambit, Tragedy of Medusa and now Athena's Revenge.  I have kept you waiting quite a long time for the sequel and I'm excited to bring closure to this wonderful story.

notes.title: Euryale's Gambit 0.11 Preview
notes.content:
We just about a month to go for this release cycle I thought I'd make a public development update.  So far we have seven scenes completed including one new bad ending.  We are on pace to close to 16 scenes by release near the end of March!  Here's what to expect:

In EG 0.11 we will get a little more background on Ceraphina before she came to the mortal plane and joined with Euryale.  She had apparently wanted to come to the mortal plane for some time.  We also see Euryale and gang reach San Francisco but not before encountering a surprise from Ceraphina's past.  Once they arrive in San Francisco, they realize they didn't leave the injustice in the East.

notes.title: Euryale's Gambit 0.8
notes.content:
In EG 0.8, Euryale makes final preparations before heading west to San Francisco and ultimately China.  There's lots of dialog in this update as Euryale essentially says goodbye to the party that will stay in the Townsville camp.  She won't see them again for several months.  Euryale also has an important conversation with Spoons where he comes clean about who Euryale really is.

[b]Euryale's Gambit 0.8 Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] 4 new scenes
[*] Extended prologue/intro
[*] Added Ashmedai encounter bad ending
[*] 3 new achievements
[*] Minor dialog fixes/changes to Spoons betrayal scene
[*] Restored plantation raid bad end scene
[/list]

[b]New Achievements:[/b]

"Bad Guesser" - prologue
"Succubus Fodder" - Ashmedai Encounter
"Grounded Goddess" - First plantation raid

NOTE: We have received lots of feedback from the community and are working hard to address the criticisms and incorporate many of the suggestions/requests.  One example is the Ashmedai bad ending, one scene we have added at the request of the community.  As for criticisms we are also taking those into consideration.  The extended prologue added in 0.8 is an example of steps to make the plot premise more clear.  The world of Euryale's Gambit is not a simple world however, so we ask for patience as much of the world will be brought out and explained throughout the story.  That said, we will continue to look for opportunities to clarify previous scenes and dialog where we can. 

Your feedback matters, so please let us know if there are parts of the story so far that are confusing or unclear.  Also, drop a review if you like the game.  We always appreciate being appreciated.
